build_sam_processor: build a SamProcessor instance from an image processor for prompt-based image segmentation
call_sam_processor: call the SamProcessor to encode images with input points, labels, and bounding boxes for segmentation
normalize_coordinates: normalize image coordinates from original dimensions to the target segmentation size
pad_points_and_labels: pad variable-length input points and labels to the maximum count in a batch for uniform tensor shapes
check_and_preprocess_points: validate and preprocess input points, labels, and bounding boxes into numpy arrays for the SAM model
